members.name: open
members.description: Actual menu Root open/defaultOpen; each menu/submenu instance owns its state. Menubar container itself exposes no selected menu value.

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Actual cancellable source request with native event/reason; controlled props remain authoritative.

events.name: onOpenChangeComplete
events.description: Actual source callback after the transition lifecycle.

events.name: onItemHighlighted
events.description: Actual inherited source callback, not command activation; context menu inherits the Menu highlight details.

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: Controlled/uncontrolled menu ownership and cancellable requests; not a CSS root. Semantic adapter part; actual React selector/ownership is in component.partBindings, not a promised Shadow DOM export.

cssParts.name: portal
cssParts.description: Portal mounting context; positioner and popup remain source-owned. Semantic adapter part; actual React selector/ownership is in component.partBindings, not a promised Shadow DOM export.
